unavailable.title: This server is not part of a cluster
unavailable.body: The cluster settings appear when distributed mode is on.

loadFailed: Could not load the cluster settings.

sheet.title: Cluster settings
sheet.description: How frontends and workers connect. Changes reach every frontend within seconds.

bus.title: Broadcast
bus.note: Frontends listen on every bus they can reach. They publish on NATS while it is reachable, and on PostgreSQL otherwise.
bus.unreachable: NATS is configured, but this frontend does not reach it. It broadcasts over PostgreSQL and is not ready until NATS is back.
bus.workers: Workers never connect to PostgreSQL. They talk to the frontends over the connections below.

nats.title: NATS
nats.note: Saving checks that this frontend reaches the NATS server. The frontends use a new address after a restart.
nats.workerUrlHint: Only if workers reach NATS at a different address. Empty means the address above.
nats.saved: Saved. Restart the frontends to use the new address.
nats.savedReachable: Saved. This frontend reaches the NATS server. Restart the frontends to use the new address.

weights.title: Connection preference
weights.note: A worker can join over NATS, WebSocket or P2P, all at once. If two workers fit a request equally well, the one reached over the connection with the higher weight gets it. A weight never beats fit. 0 means: use only when nothing else fits.

about.nats: Fastest. Workers dial the message bus.
about.websocket: Works anywhere. Workers dial this server.
about.p2p: Invite link. May go through a relay.

error.empty: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000.
error.whole: Use a whole number from 0 to 1000.

weights.saved: Saved. Every frontend uses the new weights within a few seconds.
weights.defaultsBack: The default weights are back. Every frontend uses them within a few seconds.

joining.title: Joining
joining.note: How a new worker is let in when it joins with a join token.
joining.autoApproveHint: Off by default. A worker that joins with a token waits for you to approve it. A token you mint can still choose otherwise.
joining.autoApproveOn: Anyone who holds a valid join token joins without your approval. Keep tokens short-lived and single-use.

page.supporting: Machines that run your models. {{online}} of {{total}} are online.

conn.label: Connections
conn.limitedHint: The relay limits the data or the time of this connection. Model files do not go through it.

inspector.noConnections: This worker has not reported a connection yet.
inspector.splitNote: It lends its memory to one big model that runs across machines. It has no backends and no placement rules.

add.title: Add worker
add.supporting: Connect a new machine in three steps.
add.backToWorker: Back to a worker with a join token

choose.title: How should the worker connect?
choose.note: Pick one or more. A worker can use all of them at once. You can add more later.

nats.name: NATS
nats.about: Fastest. The worker dials the message bus.
nats.needs: The NATS address must be reachable from the worker.
nats.unreachable: Configured, but this frontend does not reach it
nats.offLink: Set it up in the cluster settings

websocket.name: WebSocket
websocket.about: The worker dials this server's address with a token. Works through NAT and firewalls.

p2p.name: P2P
p2p.about: Join with an invite link. No open port. May go through a relay.

split.question: Running one large model across several machines?

single.splitNote: A model-split worker needs no cluster.

run.title: Run the command on the new machine
run.ran: I ran it, wait for the worker

token.title: Join token
token.usesHint: How many workers may join with this token. Use several for Kubernetes or Compose.
token.failed: The join token was not made: {{message}}
token.expiredNote: This token has expired. Mint a new one to get a command that works.
token.hiddenNote: The token is hidden here and added when you copy.
token.shownNote: The token is shown here. Hide it before you share your screen.

tabNote.compose: Several replicas may start together: choose how many workers may use the token.
tabNote.kubernetes: Applies a Secret and a StatefulSet. Choose how many workers may use the token for the replicas you run.

add.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.

invite.title: P2P invite
invite.note: A single-use invite link. The worker joins over P2P with it: no token and no open port.

wait.title: Wait for the worker
wait.listeningNote: Start the command on the new machine. This page updates when it connects. Nothing is stored until then.
wait.usedUp: The token has no use left.
wait.checkPeer: Check the peer ID on the machine before you approve it.
wait.stuck: Nothing yet? Check that the machine reaches this server, and that the command ran with no error.
wait.stuckInvite: Nothing yet? Check that the machine runs the command with the invite link, and that the link has not expired.
